name: Melonson Insurance Agency
tagline: Home, auto, commercial, motorcycle, recreational and surety bonds

cta.label: Get a Quote
cta.text: Call the office on (936) 336-4014 or send a note through the form, and tell us what you need covered. Someone will get back to you shortly.

hero.title: Friendly service and reliable coverage in Liberty.
hero.lead: At Melonson Insurance we are dedicated to providing our customers with friendly service. We value your business, and we have made it our mission to provide reliable services in our customer-driven approach.

overview.title: What we write for Liberty households and businesses.
overview.text: Pick a line of coverage to see what it covers, or call the office on (936) 336-4014 and talk it through with an agent.

services.title: Home Insurance
services.summary: Coverage for the house and what is in it.
services.text: Coverage for the house and what is in it, written through the carriers we represent in Liberty.
services.lead: Home is one of the lines we write. Tell us about the house and we will go through the coverage with you before anything is signed.
services.imageAlt: A single storey house with a brick chimney

covers.title: The structure
covers.text: The house itself, so it can be repaired or rebuilt after a covered loss.

covers.title: What is inside
covers.text: Furniture, clothing and the rest of the contents of the home.

covers.title: Liability at the property
covers.text: Injuries to guests and damage you are responsible for.

questions.q: How do I get a quote on my home?
questions.a: Call the office on (936) 336-4014 or send a note through the contact form and tell us about the property.

services.title: Auto Insurance
services.summary: Cover for the cars in the household.
services.text: Cover for the cars in the household, quoted through the carriers we represent, GAINSCO Auto Insurance among them.
services.lead: We write auto for drivers in and around Liberty, through the carriers we represent.
services.imageAlt: A car key resting on the bodywork of a car

covers.title: Liability
covers.text: Injuries and damage you cause to other people and their property.

covers.title: Damage to your own car
covers.text: Repairs after a wreck, and the other losses a comprehensive policy picks up.

covers.title: The carriers we represent
covers.text: GAINSCO Auto Insurance is one of the auto carriers whose coverage we write.

questions.q: Can you quote more than one carrier?
questions.a: We represent several carriers. Call the office on (936) 336-4014 and we will tell you which of them we can quote for your vehicles.

services.title: Motorcycle Insurance
services.summary: Cover for the bike on and off the road.
services.text: Cover for the bike, written as its own policy rather than as an afterthought on the car.
services.lead: Motorcycle is one of the lines we write. Tell us about the bike and how it is ridden, and we will quote it.
services.imageAlt: A motorcycle on an open road

covers.title: Liability
covers.text: Injuries and damage you cause to others while riding.

covers.title: Damage to the bike
covers.text: Repairs or replacement after a covered loss.

services.title: Recreational and ATV Insurance
services.text: Recreational vehicles and ATVs, which a home or auto policy does not cover on its own.
services.lead: Recreational and ATV is one of the lines we write. The machines that get ridden on the weekend usually need a policy of their own.
services.imageAlt: An all terrain vehicle on a wooded trail

covers.title: ATVs and off-road machines
covers.text: Cover for the machine and for the damage it causes.

covers.title: Recreational vehicles
covers.text: A separate policy for what the house and car policies leave out.

services.title: Commercial Insurance
services.summary: Cover for the business and its property.
services.text: Cover for the business and its property, written through the commercial carriers and markets we represent.
services.lead: We write commercial for businesses around Liberty, through the carriers and markets we represent. Texas Mutual, CNA, Burns & Wilcox, Hull & Company and IMS are among them.
services.imageAlt: A small commercial building beside a road

covers.title: The premises
covers.text: The building, the contents and the equipment the business runs on.

covers.title: Liability
covers.text: Claims brought against the business by customers and others.

covers.title: Workers' compensation
covers.text: Texas Mutual is among the carriers we represent for workers' compensation.

covers.title: Markets we work with
covers.text: Burns & Wilcox, Hull & Company and IMS are among the markets we place business through.

questions.a: Texas Mutual, a workers' compensation carrier, is one of the carriers we represent.

services.title: Surety Bonds
services.summary: Bonds a job or a licence calls for.
services.text: Surety bonds for the jobs and licences that call for one, written through CNA Surety and Western Surety Company.
services.lead: We write surety bonds through CNA Surety and Western Surety Company. Tell us which bond has been asked for and we will take it from there.
services.imageAlt: A person signing a document at a desk

covers.title: Bonds for a licence or a permit
covers.text: The bond a city, county or state office asks for before it will issue one.

covers.title: CNA Surety and Western Surety
covers.text: The surety markets we write bonds through.

questions.a: Bring us the request from whoever is asking for the bond. It names the type and the amount, and we go from there.

about.title: About Melonson Insurance
text: At Melonson Insurance we are dedicated to providing our customers with friendly service. We value your business.
We have made it our mission to provide reliable services in our customer-driven approach. To learn more about Melonson Insurance, and the services we can offer, please call us at (936) 336-4014.

facts.heading: Commercial and personal
facts.text: Melonson Insurance writes commercial and personal insurance, so the house, the cars and the business can be handled in the same office.
